== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1240_9</code>, Virtual Block 4 slip 07), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-07-Imperial_Stormtrooper.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-imperialstormtrooper-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Imperial Stormtrooper (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Published typos are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Clone. Blaster Rifle deploys (and fires) for free on this trooper. When this trooper fires Blaster Rifle, may draw two weapon destiny and choose one (may take other into hand). Immune to Rebel Barrier.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1240_9</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 4 set mark, slip number 07, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. The lore is the printed card's. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
